title: Computing Cox rings via the cone conjecture
summary: We initiate a program to study the Cox ring of Calabi-Yau varieties, employing the notion of Morrison-Kawamata dream spaces. In this setting, we establish an analogue of the Hu-Keel GIT constructions for Mori dream spaces. More precisely, for a Morrison-Kawamata dream space $X$, we establish a correspondence between the small $\mathbb{Q}$-factorial modifications of $X$ and the GIT quotients of $\operatorname{Spec}\operatorname{Cox}(X)$.
